body: Amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, the Digital Omnibus on AI. The machine-readable watermarking obligation in Article 50(2) is extended to 2 December 2026 for systems already on the market.
SB 26-189 repeals the earlier SB 24-205 and replaces it with a consequential-decision disclosure regime. Enforcement is stayed pending xAI v. Weiser.
The Fed, OCC, and FDIC jointly superseded SR 11-7 with SR 26-2 (OCC 2026-13). Generative and agentic AI are held out of scope pending a future request for information.
Chapter amendments align the Act with California SB 53 and create a NYDFS oversight office. Signed December 2025, effective 1 January 2027.
SB 149 has been amended in each subsequent session by SB 226, SB 271, SB 332, and HB 452.
